answer: Trust edges decay every epoch, so a trellis built once and left alone stops carrying weight within days and nobody reaches the zenith by parking keys. Each claim gets re-checked by a peer with nothing to gain from it, and the panel is voided if its members share one operator. An oasis of five friendly accounts cannot grade itself up. Budget the attack in hours: 200 identities renew 200 edges and sit 200 disjoint panels every six hours, about 1,200 panel-hours a day that pay nothing until they pass.
